title: Pet Playtime Beat
hook: Play works when the animal can choose and the object fits.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: colorful 3D pet-play storybook, toys and friendly pets, bright rounded forms, clean object separation

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child choosing enrichment with adult supervision
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: play-or-not cue -> recall beat -> target -> pretend-only gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a short clap-stop and marimba toy-bounce after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a short clap-stop and marimba toy-bounce after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Pet Playtime Beat an enrichment design song: play should fit species, age, body and safety, and the lyric repeatedly separates enrichment from food, housing, medical care and identification.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child tests 'safe, sized, supervised, optional' before calling an object a toy.
